title: Nexus / Golden Signals
description: internal/obs.ComputeGoldenSignals (README task 10.12/13.12), scraped off nexusd's /metrics by docker-compose.observability.yml's prometheus service. Every panel here is one field of obs.GoldenSignals — content-free by construction (internal/obs/allowlist.go), never a payload.

links.title: Nexus / Cost and Tools
links.tooltip: Drill into the per-tool/per-model breakdown behind a rate moving here (e.g. a cost-ceiling-breach or tool-adoption spike) — deliberately a separate dashboard, not merged: different time window (6h vs 24h) and a different review cadence (incident health vs. spend/adoption analysis).

panels.title: Completion rate by terminal reason
panels.description: sessions.terminal_reason distribution — a widening stuck_terminated or cost_exhausted slice is the first place a regression shows up.

panels.title: Stuck rate
panels.description: Fraction of terminal sessions ending stuck_terminated (internal/reliability/stuck.go's second corroborating trip). Should sit near zero.

panels.title: Cost ceiling breach rate
panels.description: Fraction of budget_decisions resolved refuse_ceiling (internal/cost.DecisionRefuseCeiling) — every refusal here is spend a tenant's own ceiling stopped, not an incident.

panels.title: Cache-read rate
panels.description: internal/promptctx's two-zone cache-stable prefix (README pattern #7) working: share of input tokens served from Anthropic's prompt cache rather than billed fresh. Higher is better.

panels.title: Unresolved in-flight claims
panels.description: claims still in_flight past the staleness window (task 6.6) — a fresh in-flight claim is a normal effect mid-flight; an old one is what write-ahead idempotency exists to catch.

panels.title: Telemetry attribute drop rate
panels.description: internal/obs/allowlist.go's DropTracker (task 34) — not measured by /metrics itself (see the metric's own HELP text); always 0 from this endpoint. Kept on the board as the documented limitation, not hidden.

panels.title: Approval decision latency (p50 / p95)
panels.description: decided_at - created_at across every DECIDED approval (internal/oversight/approval.go) — pending approvals have no decided_at and are excluded, never counted as zero-latency.

panels.title: Approval mismatch rate
panels.description: approval_mismatch events (task 5.7's digest re-verification) divided by decided approvals — every occurrence here is a modified-after-grant argument caught, not silently re-requested.

panels.title: Taint transition rate
panels.description: Fraction of terminal sessions with at least one taint_transition event on their log (internal/delegate/resolve.go's delegation-copy fold, internal/teams/board.go's board-card-read fold — constitution Principle V's Rule of Two). Deliberately NOT colored green-good/red-bad like the panels above: unlike stuck_rate or cost_ceiling_breach_rate, a rising number here isn't itself a fault — it's real work touching untrusted or sensitive content across a delegation or board read, same as an industry "guardrail fire rate" panel. Read it as a trend to notice, not a threshold to alert on; correlate a spike against a specific session's own event log before concluding anything.

panels.title: Sessions by surface
panels.description: Session count grouped by originating surface_id (web/telegram/zalo/email/cli/api — migrations/0002_sessions.sql, docs/agentic-capabilities.md's multi-surface delivery). A volume/adoption breakdown, not a rate — there's no "bad" direction here, just which channels are actually carrying traffic.
